beats.name: idle
beats.intent: fat lazy pig at rest - belly breathing, snore, ear twitch; long hold sells 'lazy'

beats.name: notice
beats.intent: wings tagged 'otari' fly in from right; pig head-snap accent then startle hold

beats.name: flee
beats.intent: scramble up and run LEFT away from incoming wings; leg-cycle bob; wings gain

beats.name: dock
beats.intent: wings chase down the pig and attach ease-out; dust puff accent

beats.name: liftoff
beats.intent: anticipation squash -> stretch launch, legs pedal in air, accelerating exit up-right off-frame
